title: comfy update
description: Output shape for `comfy update comfy --version <X>` — the headless ComfyUI version switch.

previous.description: The ref the workspace was on before the switch (short sha, plus `git describe` when it differs).

current.description: The ref the workspace is on after the switch.

stashed.description: Whether uncommitted changes were stashed before the switch. A stash is never popped or dropped automatically.

stash_ref.description: The stash reference to recover from when `stashed` is true, otherwise null.
